verdict.rationale: The firm publishes start-up materials: a TwoVenture hub with a 'Start & Seed' section, a free German term sheet generator, and share-incentive factsheets (EMI, Growth Shares, CSOP). None of the cited content explicitly addresses founder vesting schedules, 83(b)-equivalent elections, or co-founder equity splits, so support is only glancing. missing for 10: explicit founder vesting guidance, 83(b) or local-equivalent election coverage, co-founder equity split materials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
